citations.cited_text:
§98.1103  Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
(a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an
algorithmic device to a landlord.

content.text: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.

citations.cited_text:
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

content.text: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

citations.cited_text:
The following
definitions apply in this Division:
Algorithmic device means a software or product that uses or incorporates one or
more algorithms to perform calculations of nonpublic competitor data concerning
rental rates, occupancy levels, or other information regarding the leasing of
residential rental property to advise a landlord on, or recommend to a landlord,
rental rates or occupancy levels that may be achieved for a residential rental
property in the City of San Diego.

content.text: An algorithmic device means a software or product that uses or incorporates one or more algorithms to perform calculations of nonpublic competitor data concerning rental rates, occupancy levels, or other information regarding the leasing of residential rental property to advise a landlord on, or recommend to a landlord, rental rates or occupancy levels that may be achieved for a residential rental property in the City of San Diego.

citations.cited_text:
Algorithmic device does not include either of
the following:
(a) A software or product used by a person to publish reports regarding rental
rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor
data that is more than 90 days old, or from information available to the
general public, and does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels
for future residential rental property leases or renewals.
(b) A software or product used by a person to establish rental rates or income
limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing
program guidelines.

content.text: Algorithmic device does not include: (a) A software or product used by a person to publish reports regarding rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data that is more than 90 days old, or from information available to the general public, and does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels for future residential rental property leases or renewals; or (b) A software or product used by a person to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.

For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.

§98.1104  Remedies
( a ) A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to
$1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord.
In an action brought under this Division, a prevailing tenant shall recover
costs and reasonable attorney’s fees.

content.text: A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation of this Division, in a civil action against a landlord. In an action brought under this Division, a prevailing tenant shall recover costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
